White S, Quinn J, Enzor J, Staats J, Mosier SM, Almarode J, Denny TN, Weinhold KJ, Ferrari G and Chan C (2021). FlowKit: A Python Toolkit for Integrated Manual and Automated Cytometry Analysis Workflows. Frontiers in Immunology 12:768541. DOI:10.3389/fimmu.2021.768541.
Figure 2 is reproduced in full from https://www.frontiersin.org/files/Articles/768541/xml-images/fimmu-12-768541-g002.webp under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Only an external bilingual title and attribution were added. The plotted distributions are the authors' measured EQAPOL data; no raw data have been inferred from the image.

All other event clouds and numerical examples are original constructed teaching data with seed909.
